</details>

<details>
This PKGBUILD is a straightforward binary package that downloads a .deb file from the project's own GitHub releases repository (`mathisdev7/screenix-releases`) and extracts its contents into the package directory using `bsdtar`. The source URL matches the project's own upstream (`url="https://github.com/mathisdev7/screenix"`), and there are no suspicious network requests, obfuscated code, unexpected file operations, or dangerous commands (eval, base64, curl, wget, etc.).
